# function: color

Converts a hex RGB color such as `#5865F2`, `5865f2` or `#fff` to the integer Discord uses for role and embed colors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_role" "blurple" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  name      = "Blurple"
  color     = provider::discord::color("#5865F2")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
color(hex string) number
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `hex` (String) Hex color, with or without a leading `#`.
